mapper.insert: INSERT INTO target_product_judgement (mydata_trade_id, ci_hash, stock_type, fund_code, fund_name, ticker, is_target, foreign_stock_ratio, inception_date, judged_at, trade_type, amount, trade_date, net_buy_amount) VALUES (#{mydataTradeId}, #{ciHash}, #{stockType}, #{fundCode}, #{fundName}, #{ticker}, #{isTarget}, #{foreignStockRatio}, #{inceptionDate}, #{judgedAt}, #{tradeType}, #{amount}, #{tradeDate}, #{netBuyAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT failure_id AS failureId, mydata_trade_id AS mydataTradeId, ci_hash AS ciHash, trade_date AS tradeDate, failure_count AS failureCount, last_error AS lastError, first_failed_at AS firstFailedAt, last_failed_at AS lastFailedAt FROM target_product_judgement_failure WHERE mydata_trade_id = #{mydataTradeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO target_product_judgement_failure (mydata_trade_id, ci_hash, trade_date, failure_count, last_error, first_failed_at, last_failed_at) VALUES (#{mydataTradeId}, #{ciHash}, #{tradeDate}, #{failureCount}, #{lastError}, #{firstFailedAt}, #{lastFailedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE failure_count = #{failureCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, last_failed_at = #{lastFailedAt}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS todayJudgementCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_target = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayTargetCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN is_target = TRUE THEN net_buy_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayTargetNetBuyAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trade_type IN ('INHERITANCE', 'GIFT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayInheritanceGiftCount FROM target_product_judgement WHERE judged_at >= #{today} AND judged_at < #{tomorrow}
